state.consultation_scope: Planning disposition only. No code/library execution, policy adoption, migration, new implementation goal or retirement authorized by the response.
state.human_goal: Reduce readable production mechanics and maintenance across complete owners/callers while preserving required Can outcomes; added capability and correctness have separate budgets.
state.uri_evidence: Three Rust Work decision modules separately reproduce encodeURIComponent over UTF16, differing in local U16/error shells. Persisted recurring/dispatch/row identities require ASCII letters/digits and -_.!~*'() unchanged; other UTF8 bytes use uppercase %HH, never +; lone surrogates return URIError (engine text not exact). The existing TS primitives/donors remain needed. Cached percent-encoding2.3.2 is MIT/Apache, zero dependencies, alloc optional/no_std, caller-defined ASCII set, encodes nonASCII bytes and uppercase hex. Standard strict String::from_utf16 rejects unpaired surrogates; no lossy conversion is permitted. One private Work helper plus local typed error shells could replace three loops. Crate absent actual root assembly; no new runtime, target-footprint, byte corpus or final net reduction demonstrated. Sharing the existing loop avoids dependency burden but keeps manual UTF16/UTF8/hex mechanics.
state.locale_evidence: Current exact display uses BigInt/decimal text with retained authored scale; Intl supplies separators, signs and grouping probes, then Can assembles ASCII digits. This omits localized digit/bidi literals/minimum grouping behavior. Required outcomes include exact typed numeric/currency locale display; current byte quirks are observed public baseline, not all independently mandated product semantics. ECMA4022025 provides string ToIntlMathematicalValue; a direct exact decimal-string formatter may retire manual grouping/reconstruction without Number rounding. Actual supported Node/Worker/browser coverage, locale/data-release reproducibility and callers/exports have not been qualified. Author-scale zeros, type/range/error and safe plural refusal are separate rules; this candidate must not silently alter them. Switching locale digits/bidi/minimum grouping changes observable output and requires explicit proposed public-contract decision and consumer/host acceptance. A new self-contained locale library could pin data but introduces representation, dependency and release/data owners; none is currently qualified.

uri_strategy.instructions: Which current planning disposition best balances preserved persisted URI bytes, fewer Can mechanisms, dependency burden and credible qualification? Select a finite direction, not runtime acceptance.

criteria.library_candidate_gate: Select one Work-private strict UTF16 plus percent-encoding2.3.2 candidate. Keep byte/error policy and local shells; replace loops only after independent exact-domain/target and full owner/caller net-reduction gates. If it fails, retain existing mechanics rather than ship two routes.
criteria.shared_existing_gate: Select private consolidation of current URI mechanics with local error/carrier boundaries. No new crate, but custom scalar/byte escape ownership remains; require parity and actual net reduction before retiring copies.
criteria.retain_copies_now: Retain all three current native loops until broader native consumer adoption. No new dependency or change risk now, but duplicates persist; explicitly retain their retirement gates.

locale_strategy.instructions: For exact locale numeric display, choose the current planning policy among preservation, explicitly proposed platform presentation change or new data-engine evaluation. Which fits required outcomes and simplicity at this evidence stage?

criteria.retain_current_profile: Retain current exact assembler now. Inventory output consumers and settle locale/data/host support before choosing a different presentation profile; do not permanently assert every ASCII/bidi quirk as a product mandate.
criteria.platform_profile_gate: Propose one exact-string Intl presentation profile, with explicit localized digit/bidi/minimum grouping changes and preserved authored scale/exact values/errors. Adoption and old assembler retirement wait for contract release, real callers/host-data evidence and measured reduction; no plural-domain or silent fallback change.
criteria.bundled_engine_gate: Prioritize evaluation of a single bundled locale engine/data owner before platform substitution. Retain current implementation meanwhile; justify added dependency/data/representation/delivery burden and prove the same exact outcome domain before selecting it.
